title: Stellar Discovery Trust Layer
subtitle: Stellar Forge · SCF Open Track product presentation

chapters.title: From a useful resource to a retained result
chapters.label: STELLAR FORGE
captions: Stellar Discovery Trust Layer connects a merchant’s useful API or data to an approved Stellar purchase and a retained result.

chapters.title: The builder and the engineering team
chapters.label: INDIVIDUAL APPLICANT
captions: Bryce Muhlnickel directs product, delivery and commercial relationships as the individual applicant.
AI agents assist with engineering, review and documentation, including this presentation.

chapters.title: Start with a useful merchant query
chapters.label: ORIGINAL REVIEWED MYSQL PACKAGE
captions: This merchant package exposes the retained NYC HPD project-event data through its reviewed Preservation filter and minimum twenty units.
The selected response contains one hundred rows and fourteen columns, with exact scalar strings and the configured source limit.

chapters.title: Reopen the original buyer’s work
chapters.label: MAINTAINED MCP BUYER CONSOLE
captions: The original buyer console reopens the completed intent. Its history keeps the status, attempt and retained result together.
Earlier unsuccessful authorization remains a separate historical record.

chapters.title: Keep the purchased request and terms together
chapters.label: ORIGINAL CLOSED QUOTE
captions: The saved quote identifies the selected tool, exact request and original Stellar payment terms.
The native purchase used fifty thousand stroops, or 0.005 testnet XLM. Its original intent remains the point of reference.

chapters.title: Read the completed native payment
chapters.label: RETAINED STELLAR TESTNET OBSERVATION
captions: The maintained console displays the independently matched transfer at ledger 5,145,195.
This is the original completed purchase. Its retained transaction and result can be inspected with the payment adapter disconnected.

chapters.title: Use the data the buyer received
chapters.label: COMPLETE ORIGINAL MCP RESULT
captions: Open the complete purchased result, including the typed HPD rows and their source fields.
The original response contains one hundred rows and fourteen columns. The configured truncation flag stays visible.
Download the same 53,468 bytes of JSON. Scalar strings and the original payment response remain intact.

chapters.title: Continue the same operation after reopening
chapters.label: ORIGINAL RESULT AND HISTORY
captions: Close and reopen the workspace, then select the same completed intent.
The exact saved response and retained transaction observation are still available. Reading the result does not require another payment.

chapters.title: Install and hand over the working product
chapters.label: MAINTAINED SOURCE AND OPERATING GUIDES
captions: The maintained release includes the merchant package, native buyer, complete-result tools and operating guides.
A receiving operator can inspect the saved package, reopen the buyer’s result and continue through the original support and recovery workflow.

chapters.title: The proposed grant funds independent deployment
chapters.label: $38,000 · 400 FUTURE HOURS · 150 DAYS
captions: The current proposal takes this working baseline to two independent merchant operators and two independent buyer operators.
By day ninety, complete ten useful testnet purchases in seven days. By day one hundred fifty, complete thirty mainnet purchases across fourteen days, with both buyers returning.
These are proposed funded outcomes. Seven team-operated testnet purchases have already delivered usable retained results.

chapters.title: One operation, delivered and recoverable
chapters.label: OPEN SOURCE · STELLAR FORGE
captions: Inspect the maintained source, install the product, and follow one useful merchant operation through purchase, result and operator handover.
